fields.notes: IO-Link does not ship an embedded testbench, but the standard implies a verification plan spanning the wake-up and SIO<->SDCI mode switch, the COM-rate detection and 8-E-1 framing, the M-sequence CKT/CKS checksums, the cyclic Process Data and MinCycleTime, the ISDU parameter access, Events, and the Device state machine. IO-Link (IEC 61131-9, SDCI) compliance testing supplies the formal suite.
verification_categories_derived_from_spe: Wake-up / mode switch — the wake-up request switches SIO to SDCI.
UART framing — 8-E-1 at each COM rate.
M-sequence — Master message + Device response with CKT/CKS (TYPE_0/1/2).
Process Data — cyclic exchange up to 32 bytes per direction.
On-request Data / ISDU — Index/Subindex read/write and segmentation.
Device states — STARTUP / PREOPERATE / OPERATE via MasterCommand.
MinCycleTime — the Master respects the Device's minimum cycle time.
Error handling — parity, CKT/CKS, timeout, fallback to SIO.
